text:
alex: Quick heads-up — GA for two new Hosted models is live: "mx-slim" (cost-optimized) and "mx-pro" (latency-optimized). Both support streaming + tool-calling. Docs & migration guide: https://internal.redwood.dev/hosted/mx-ga

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary rollout to us-west-2 succeeded for svc/hosted-api-v2 :white_check_mark:

jordan: Nice — will the default alias change? does "mosaicx" still point to the same model?

anna: Product update — the "mosaicx" alias will point to mx-pro starting next Tue (UTC). mx-slim will remain available by explicit name. We'll publish an alias change timeline and a list of customers we plan to contact in the doc.

mike: Any billing/pricing changes folks should know about? token rates or new SKUs?

anna: Pricing notes in the guide: mx-slim maps to the new hosted-slim SKU (~0.6x token cost). mx-pro keeps the existing token unit but may incur a latency premium on reserved Dedicated SKUs. Full spreadsheet linked in docs.

emily-prod: Ops note — streaming concurrent connection default increased from 25 -> 40 per instance. Updated autoscaler defaults and connection pools. Watch socket churn during the canary.

ops-oncall: Dashboards added: /dashboards/mx-ga-latency and /dashboards/mx-ga-toolcalls. Runbook pinned. Paging thresholds: p95 token latency > 350ms sustained for 5m triggers a page.

jordan: How about Dedicated/private deployments — compatibility?

emily-prod: Dedicated will get a binary/patch next week; clusters must set --enable-toolcalls to opt into tool-calling until the next linchpin release. We'll publish migration commands.

mike: Can we get a quick migration snippet to share with customers?

anna: Sure, sample curl for Hosted streaming + tool-calls:
```bash
curl -N -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"mx-slim","stream":true,"tool_calls":true,"input":"Summarize the following..."}'
```

alex: Rollout plan = canary -> 24h monitor -> region ramp -> global flip. Deprecation: mosaicx-v1 will be deprecated in 60 days; we will send customer notices and add migration helpers in the SDKs.

devtools-bot: Docs PR #482 merged; changelog entry created.

ops-oncall: Please run quick smoke tests for websocket streaming + tool call flows in staging. If you hit errors tag @ops-oncall and paste logs.

anna: We’ll run a 30-min town hall / Q&A tomorrow 09:30 PT in #product. Recording + slides will be posted.

alex: Thanks everyone — big milestone. If you have customers in the early access cohort, please coordinate comms with @support and @sales. :rocket:
